projects.title: Pump Reliability Analysis
projects.description: Analysis and optimization of pump performance in mining operations
projects.challenge: Equipment reliability issues causing operational downtime and maintenance costs in mining operations
projects.role: Lead analysis on pump condition monitoring and predictive maintenance systems
projects.process: Implemented condition monitoring system using vibration analysis and performance metrics to identify failure patterns before equipment breakdown
projects.results: Reduced unplanned downtime by optimizing maintenance schedules based on data insights

projects.title: Ball Mill & Pipeline Maintenance System
projects.description: Comprehensive maintenance strategy for critical equipment including pumps, pipelines, and ball mills
projects.challenge: Managing maintenance for multiple critical equipment types to maintain operational continuity
projects.role: Equipment maintenance specialist responsible for pumps, pipelines, and ball mills
projects.process: Developed integrated maintenance planning approach combining preventive and condition-based strategies
projects.results: Improved equipment lifecycle management and extended operational lifetime

projects.title: 3D Plant Modeling & Digital Twin
projects.description: Development of 3D petrochemical plant models using SmartPlant 3D for engineering documentation and simulation
projects.challenge: Creating accurate digital representations of complex petrochemical plant infrastructure for design and operational reference
projects.role: Junior engineer responsible for 3D modeling and digital twin development
projects.process: Utilized SmartPlant 3D to create detailed 3D models capturing equipment layout, piping, and instrumentation
projects.results: Delivered comprehensive plant documentation enabling improved design collaboration and operation planning

projects.title: Bulk Carrier Construction & Technical Documentation
projects.description: On-the-job training observing bulk carrier construction and learning shipbuilding processes and techniques
projects.challenge: Understanding complex shipbuilding construction techniques and specialized equipment operations
projects.role: OJT participant observing bulk carrier construction and technical documentation
projects.process: Participated in bulk carrier construction observing hull fabrication, equipment installation, and specialized machinery (FCB machines, ship benders)
projects.results: Gained practical knowledge of shipbuilding processes and specialized engineering applications

projects.title: Coconut Dehusking Machine (Thesis)
projects.description: University thesis project designing and fabricating an automated coconut dehusking machine
projects.challenge: Engineer an efficient mechanical solution for coconut processing while considering manufacturability and safety
projects.role: Primary thesis researcher and designer responsible for mechanical design, analysis, and fabrication
projects.process: Performed comprehensive CAD design using SolidWorks, conducted FEA for structural analysis, and oversaw fabrication of working prototype
projects.results: Successfully completed and fabricated thesis project demonstrating mechanical engineering design workflow from concept through prototype
